items.title: Monthly payroll check before pay day
evidence: Every month, three days before pay day, Tomas runs a Workday report and fixes any pay that differs from last month by more than 10%.
Nobody else has run this check in the last year.

items.title: Workday report: Pay differences this month
evidence: Tomas built and owns this custom Workday report. It is shared with the Payroll team.

items.title: Ines Calder (payroll vendor contact)
evidence: Monthly call with Ines Calder at the payroll vendor. Notes are kept in the shared Payroll folder.
